title: Blue Rancher Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Blue Rancher Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
Smooth Satisfaction in Every Puff
The Blue Rancher Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 delivers an elevated vaping experience, perfect for those seeking convenience coupled with exceptional taste. With its pre-filled, disposable format, you can enjoy hassle-free vaping anytime, anywhere.
A Burst of Irresistible Flavor
Indulge in the Blue Rancher flavor—a tantalizing mix that dances on your taste buds with every puff. Whether you’re a seasoned vaper or new to the scene, the rich, smooth flavor profile promises a consistently delightful experience.
Designed for Convenience
No refills. Crafted to fit seamlessly into your on-the-go lifestyle, this disposable vape offers effortless usage while maintaining a sleek, compact design. Once you’ve reached the end of its impressive lifespan, simply dispose of it responsibly.
The Ultimate Vaping Experience
With up to 25,000 puffs packed into this powerful device, the Blue Rancher Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 redefines long-lasting satisfaction. It’s more than a vape; it’s your gateway to a flavorful, smooth-as-clouds experience. Take the leap and make every puff count!
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 5% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow
:
Adjustable for customized draw
